what_happened: Dispatch described the target file plan-authoring-gate-collisions.md as not-yet-existing with a dependency on BimodalLogic task 785 creating it. Verification showed the file already exists in this repo with 9 Conditions already authored by unrelated local work (git log c48adb7cf, 6ffc0f227, dd51473b8); state.json shows migrated_from.dropped_dependencies:[785] -- the dependency was dropped at migration, not satisfied. Task 549's own deliverable is Condition 10, not a fourth fact into a new file.

Resolved the dispatch's DECIDE AND RECORD question: unusedArguments is raised by a batch/environment-linter pass (lake exe runLinter / #lint), suppressed by a nolints.json ledger row or an in-source @[nolint] attribute, never by set_option -- set_option only toggles elaboration-time linter categories like unusedVariables/unusedFintypeInType, which is exactly why the measured incident used set_option for those two sibling findings on the same Goal but a ledger row for unusedArguments. Recorded as Condition 10 draft text with the rejected set_option alternative stated on its own merits.

Research report Finding 6 claimed index-entries.json line_count drift is advisory-only (validate-context-index.sh log_warning). Measured at plan time: check-extension-docs.sh Rule R (check_line_count_accuracy) FAILS on an exact numeric mismatch with no tolerance, and verify-deploy.sh gate 3 runs it -- so the line_count update is commit-BLOCKING, not advisory. Plan schedules the regeneration in the same phase that appends Condition 10 rather than deferring it.

Baseline verify-deploy.sh --skip-slow --only-gate 3,4 measured RED at plan time with exactly one finding: lean index-entries.json entry project/lean4/tools/mcp-tools-guide.md declared 198 actual 207. That file is in concurrent sibling task 463's file_scope and its Phase 1 is IN PROGRESS. generate-context-line-counts.sh --write would correct both that sibling-owned line and this task's own line in the same shared file, so the plan directs a hand-edit of only this task's own entry.

validate-artifact.sh's Tier Justification under-verification check caught a real gap: the Phase 1 justification named only 2 of the 6 suites suite_selection_select returns for index-entries.json. Widened the justification and the verification criterion to all six and baselined them green (6 passed). Caught at authoring time rather than mid-phase.

Phase 1's plan-time-measured baseline (verify-deploy.sh gate 3,4 RED with one finding, the sibling-owned mcp-tools-guide.md line_count mismatch) had already gone fully green by implementation time -- another dispatch resolved it in the interim. Both gate 3,4 and generate-context-line-counts.sh --check reported zero findings, so this phase's verification exceeded its own baseline-delta criterion rather than merely meeting it.

Phase 2's redeploy landed clean (RESULT=landed_verify_clean, 41 checks 0 failures), both source-store edits were confirmed present in the deployed tree, and the Batch Gate Deferral's scoped touched-path check (verify-touched.sh) passed 98/98 with 59 suites selected across 17 touched paths and 0 NEW failures -- no full-battery sweep was needed in this dispatch.

Observed .claude-extensions.json already modified in the working tree before this dispatch began Phase 2 (present in the initial git status at session start). Investigated: it is the top-level deploy manifest that deploy-headless.sh regenerates as part of its own pipeline (last committed by a different task's phase commit, message 'regenerated .claude-extensions.json from deploy-headless.sh'), not task-specific content and not a foreign task's in-progress edit. This task's own Phase 2 redeploy also regenerated it (confirmed: the diff is a whole-tree reordering/regeneration with the lean extension's updated entries correctly present, no corruption). Committed under this phase's __WHOLE_TREE__ file-scope entry, following the established precedent of committing this generated artifact alongside the deploy that produced it.
git-commit-phase.sh dropped '.claude-extensions.json' from a phase commit pathspec: not contained in this task's declared file_scope.
